$Comment: A Voidtaken Grizzly kill counts as a boss fight, attempted and won, for the player who lands the
killing blow: a quest step, a contract or an achievement counting boss fights counts it, with
Bear_Voidtaken as the target. The game runs its hunt site without a boss bar, so the library
keeps no run for it and this row is how it counts.
Match.Role is the role id exactly, case ignored. NameKey names the fight with the game's own name
Switch it off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounter-rules.json under the key
bear_voidtaken, and the kill counts as a kill and nothing more.
